title: “It's up to us to make refilling attractive,” Mandana Vahedi, Planet B
summary: At just 26, Mandana Vahedi has already taken on several major challenges in luxury beauty packaging. After an initial internship at L'Oréal Luxe, she joined Puig in Spain, where she worked on the Carolina Herrera makeup line. She is now a Product Development Project Manager at Planet B, the Belgian company behind WONDR (personal care and beauty) and POWR (laundry and household care). Her mission is to make sustainable choices easy. Mandana Vahedi is among the talents selected for the Future... - Packaging & design / A la une

products.name: aluminium can refills for WONDR shampoo, shower gel and conditioner
products.launch_quote: I work hand in hand with suppliers, labs and manufacturers to turn bold ideas into real products, like our latest launches: aluminium can refills for WONDR shampoo, shower gel and conditioner, and a sugarcane-based bottle for POWR liquid laundry detergent.
